reason: I don't buy things from an ad, I buy from people I know. Nobody I know uses this yet, and I'm not letting a robot change my prices and my Google page on its own word.
objection: Will the AI put a wrong price on my site or a wrong closing time on Google, and customers come and shout at me? And who do I call when it goes wrong, a chat bot?
would_change_my_mind: Another café owner I know telling me she uses it and it never got her prices wrong, and someone who comes in person to set it up with me.
